_comment: InfinityOS Wine/Proton fix playbook. Injected into AI context for gaming issues.

common_errors.diagnosis: Missing Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLL
common_errors.notes: Run all four — games often need a specific version and winetricks handles it gracefully
Same package as vcrun, covers msvcp*.dll files
DXVK translates DirectX 9/10/11 to Vulkan — faster and more compatible than wined3d
Required for gamepad/controller support in many Windows games
Used by older Microsoft/Xbox games for audio
Required for games using PhysX physics engine
dotnet48 is the most compatible version. Some older games need dotnet40 or dotnet35
vcomp*.dll is part of the Visual C++ redistribution package

common_errors.diagnosis: Application crash — could be missing runtime or incompatible Wine version
common_errors.notes: Run with full debug to see what actually failed before guessing at a fix

common_errors.diagnosis: Harmless warning — heap settings not implemented
common_errors.fix: No fix needed — this is a benign Wine 'fixme' message, not a real error
common_errors.notes: Can be suppressed with WINEDEBUG=-fixme+all if it's cluttering logs

common_errors.pattern: Could not find compatible graphics hardware|Vulkan.*not.*available
common_errors.diagnosis: Vulkan not available or not detected
common_errors.fix: sudo apt install mesa-vulkan-drivers vulkan-tools libvulkan1 && vulkaninfo --summary
common_errors.notes: If vulkaninfo works but Wine/Proton can't find it, try: DISABLE_LAYER_AMD_SWITCHABLE_GRAPHICS_1=1 %command%

common_errors.fix: In Steam: right-click game → Properties → Compatibility → Force Proton-GE
common_errors.notes: Some games have issues with Steam's built-in container. Proton-GE often fixes it.

notes.wineprefix_32bit: Some old games need a 32-bit prefix: WINEARCH=win32 WINEPREFIX=~/.wine32 wine app.exe
notes.dxvk_vs_wined3d: DXVK (Vulkan) is almost always faster and more compatible than wined3d for DX9/10/11 games
notes.proton_vs_wine: Use Proton-GE for Steam games (via Steam compatibility settings). Use plain Wine for non-Steam Windows apps.
notes.heroic_wine: Heroic uses its own Wine/Proton — configure per-game in Heroic's game settings, not system Wine
